rationale: The stock gapped up ~11% on strong earnings but has since sold off dramatically from the session high of $167.97 to $151.91, now sitting just 0.25% above today's low with price well below VWAP ($161.00) and the 9-EMA ($155.13), indicating aggressive selling pressure overwhelming the positive catalyst. The bid-ask spread of 75 bps signals poor liquidity for a clean entry, and with price at the bottom of today's range in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.82%, VIXY +3.43%), the risk/reward for either direction is unclear — a long risks further breakdown through the session low, while a short risks a snap-back given the strong fundamental catalyst still in play.
